chapter: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part III
act_title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part III

quests.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part III

dialogue.t: Oil, salt, sauce, vinegar... Right, that's everything we need.
Why, {NICKNAME}, this year's off to a good start, wouldn't you say?
Morning {NICKNAME}. Time to fire up the stove for another day of customers. Thanks again!

dialogue.sit: With days of experience now under your belt, the work is becoming second nature...

dialogue.t: Great work... You're looking more like a head chef every day! Hehe, whatever crazy characters come walking through that door, I know you'll be able to handle them...
Wait, no! Every time you say something like that, you jinx it!
Hey, that's not true! Anyway, I didn't mean it like that...
Ahahahaha!
Dude! What up, bro!? I didn't know you were in Liyue too! Ah, it's always nice to run into a broad Inazuman fellow... Wait, did I say that right?
Almost. I think you meant "fellow Inazuman abroad," Boss.
Yeah, yeah, that's the one! We gotta look out for each other when we're this far from home! Don't we, Ayato?
Hehe...
...Bull-Chucker! What are you doing here!?
Huh? Oh hey, Flying Lavender Melon... uh, of the "Skycleaving White Iron" variety! And my compadre, too! All my buddies in one place, today's my lucky day!
Didn't you say you were gonna knuckle down and earn some Mora when you got home? How come you're back in Liyue so soon?

Haha, that can wait. As soon as I announce that Arataki Itto is available for hire, they'll be throwing Mora at me... Right now, I got a more urgent situation to attend to: I'm in the mood for some good, spicy food!
...Oh, and while we're here, we were also gonna see if Grandmaster Hanakado's okay, and whatnot.

dialogue.sit: (The look on Shinobu's face seems to say... "Don't ask.")
So what about you, Ayato?

dialogue.t: ...Not too long ago, I heard a rumor that someone was hosting an Onikabuto-fighting contest in Liyue. Naturally, I came here as soon as I could... but alas, it was too late.
What? You missed it? Aw man, what a bummer!
Quite the bummer indeed — though all is not lost. Since you're here, you'll be able to tell me all about it.
Haha, sure thing my man! But let's catch up over some food... Where's the chef, anyway? Hey, get the chef out here — I got compadres to feed!

dialogue.sit: I'm the chef.

dialogue.t: Yeah, sure, me too... What!?
Wow, Bull-Chucker set that one up for us really nicely. Gotta give him some credit for that!

dialogue.sit: ...But the main chef is another guy.

dialogue.t: Uh... Haha, good one compadre, you almost got me there. Alright, well get the chef out here!

dialogue.sit: You and Paimon go to the kitchen and fetch Smiley Yanxiao...

dialogue.t: So, uh... May I take your order? If you're entertaining guests, I can recommend The Palace Jewels, a Trembling Strings and Rushing Reeds, or...
...Boss, don't forget the budget.
Yeah, okay, um... Got anything a little more, uh... down to earth?
Down to earth...? Oh... Well, we do a mean "Humbly Enough." Real hearty dish with a ton of flavor, and we don't skimp on the portion size either. That'd be the best value for your Mora...
Humbly Enough, huh? Sounds like my kind of grub! We'll take that — no need for anything fancy, we're all friends here!
Excellent choice, Itto — I'm no fan of culinary ostentation either. Heh... sometimes a bro just knows, hmm?
A bro just knows... Yes, a bro just knows! Bros don't suppose, 'cause bros just knows!
Is this for real? ...Whatever, Paimon's leaving you guys to it.
Gotta say, your friend's quite a character... Still, Humbly Enough isn't that hard to make, so I don't think we'll have any problems with this order.
Actually, why is it called "Humbly Enough" anyway? A hearty meat dish is a good start, but in Paimon's experience, one humble dish is never enough!
Uh, I said it was hearty, but I never said it contained meat... Don't be fooled by the appearance — it's actually just tofu made to look and taste like meat.

dialogue.sit: Tofu!?

dialogue.t: Wait! Tofu is made of beans, isn't it... Bull-Chucker can't eat that! Guess we'll have to get them to pick something else instead...
...What's the issue? I think I caught the word "tofu"...
Wait, what are you doing? The kitchen is staff members only... *sigh* Never mind, I'll let it slide. Ma'am, could you possibly ask your Boss to order something else instead?
...Haha! No one gets my bro Ayato like I do! I hereby declare that Humbly Enough will be an everlasting symbol of our friendship, or my name ain't Arataki Itto!
...Hey! Where's our food at? Hurry up, I'm almost done recounting the epic adventures of Crimson Staff!
...As you can see, changing the order may be a little difficult.
Oh brother, his whole ego is riding on this, huh... Even if we break the news to him, he'd probably rather eat the tofu than eat his words...

dialogue.sit: We're locked in now... We gotta cook that dish...
How about we throw some free appetizers in?

dialogue.t: Sounds good. I'll make sure he fills up on those... We'll just have to play the rest by ear.
The air was getting stifling, so I made some excuses and slipped away... Anyway, thanks for taking the hint earlier. I'll fill you in later.
...Seriously, if I'd blinked I would've missed it! Crimson Staff just launched itself at Bloom Pruner and sent it flying!
I'd expect no less of the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King himself. It sounds like a truly epoch-defining duel.
I never knew tofu allergy was even a thing... Okay, I'll handle the appetizers, you take care of the main event.
I can help, too. Don't worry, I'm qualified — I passed Liyue's senior culinary exam once.
Uh... Food's here...
Oho, so this is Humbly Enough? You guys don't mess around! Love me that portion size!
Come on, compadre, grab a seat. We're all friends here, so don't hold back! I'm just gonna dig right in...
Ahem! Boss, we should respect the local customs. Here in Liyue, it's polite to let the guests eat first.
Polite? Uh... Shinobu, I thought old-timey traditions weren't your style...

dialogue.sit: Now that I've finished in the kitchen, I'm a guest too.
Maybe let me dig in first?

dialogue.t: Huh? Are you kidding me, compadre? ...Ohh wait, I get it. The food smells so dang good, now everyone's dying to go first! Well, guess I only got my own good taste to blame. Go on, dive in, I'll wait till last!

dialogue.sit: You, Paimon, Ayato, and Shinobu help yourselves, leaving very little "meat" behind...

dialogue.t: ...Hah, I see.
Finally, it's my turn! Hoohoo, I spy a big chunk of deliciousness with my name on it...
Wait, don't!
Huh? What is it now?

dialogue.sit: You got this, Paimon.
You know the drill...

dialogue.t: Uh... Okay, here goes... Anyway, so uh, Paimon forgot to tell you the really cool origin story of this dish!
Origin story? Dude, who cares where it came from — we all know where it's going! Am I right? Down the gullet!
Uh, well, umm... Skipping the origin story is like... like going traveling without a tour guide! Trust Paimon, you'll get way more out of the experience after you hear it...
Paimon makes an astute observation. Much as every tea must be appreciated on its own terms, is it not a waste of the chef's goodwill to sample a dish without hearing its tale?
My compadre's goodwill, huh? Can't have that going to waste... Alright then, gimme the full story! I'm all ears!
That's more like it! Let's start with the ingredients... Actually, no, let's start with the story of Wangshu Inn... which starts with the history of Dihua Marsh...
(Now's our chance, {NICKNAME}!)

dialogue.sit: (Got it!)
While Itto is distracted, you and Shinobu begin to gobble down the dish...

dialogue.t: ...Man, the tale of Dihua Marsh hits hard... People in the past had it pretty rough. Makes you appreciate what you got. "Humbly enough"... that's a good way to think about life.
(Darn, there's no segue to tofu from here... How'd we get so off topic? Ugh. Well, good news is there's only a little bit left!)

dialogue.sit: (But we're already... beyond stuffed...)

dialogue.t: Aaah! Compadre, Shinobu! Have you been eating this whole time!? Save me some dregs, why don't ya!
That's it, I'm done waiting! It's my turn to eat!
Wait! Boss, that's made of—
One moment, Itto. I... have a small request, if you would be so kind as to consider it.

I left home in a hurry, and was unable to bring any of my family with me. They've all heard so much about you and are huge admirers of the Arataki Gang, so they will be devastated to learn that they missed out on this opportunity.
However... if you were willing to let me bring the remaining portion of Humbly Enough back to them, I'm sure it will help to lift their spirits.
Ehh... Yeah, I dunno...
Boss, you gotta do right by your friends. They're pretty big on that in Liyue... Besides, you did eat quite a lot of the grilled fish while we were waiting for the main course...
...Including mine and Ayato's.
Huh? Those were for you guys!? Ah, dang it... I got too carried away telling that story, didn't I...
Ah, in that case... Pass my regards to your fam, bro! El Chefe, can we get the rest of this to go?
Looks like that's all sorted? Alright, take some time to collect yourself — the next big group is coming in.

dialogue.sit: The rest of the day passes without incident...

dialogue.t: "Count Crushmore," "Instant Kill"... I never knew there were so many elite beetle-fighters in Liyue.

dialogue.sit: You didn't really come for the Onikabuto-fighting contest, did you...?

dialogue.t: Heh, can you imagine? That would be tardiness of the most unfashionable variety. No, in truth, this trip is part-business, part-leisure.

dialogue.sit: How come you didn't come to the Lantern Rite then?

dialogue.t: Every visitor has their own agenda. For some, the festivities are all the more reason to visit, for others, all the more reason to avoid the crowds.
In any case, one way or another I seem to have ended up in the right place at the right time... Now, as for the leftover tofu... yes, I'm sure Thoma will dispose of it as he sees fit.
I have to get back to the docks as soon as this meal is done...

dialogue.sit: So, why did you really come to Liyue?

dialogue.t: Well, uh... thing is...
...I can explain. Boss recently found work as a sailor, which allowed him to hitch a ride here.
After the ship docked, he had some free time to do as he pleases. He's been using that time to hang out with Grandmaster Hanakado.
Just because he's here already! No other reason!

quests.description: According to Smiley Yanxiao, you should be fine no matter how tricky the customer. But it seems that his every such utterance tempts fate…
